progress.discovering: Searching your network for CyberPower PDUs…

discovered.title: CyberPower PDU
discovered.description: PDUs found on your network are listed below. You can also scan a specific subnet or add PDUs by IP address.

fallback.title: Add CyberPower PDUs
fallback.description: No PDUs were found automatically. This is expected when Home Assistant runs in a Docker container with bridge networking (it can only see its own network, not your LAN) or when your subnet is too large to sweep. You can scan a specific subnet, or add PDUs by IP address. For automatic discovery, run Home Assistant with host or macvlan networking.

scan_subnet.title: Scan a subnet
scan_subnet.description: Enter the subnet or address range where your PDUs live. Each address is probed with unicast SNMP, so this works even when Home Assistant can't see your LAN directly (e.g. bridged Docker).

data_description.community: SNMP v1 read community used for the scan (default: public).

pick.title: Add CyberPower PDUs
pick.description: Select the PDUs to add. They will share the SNMP credentials you enter next.

manual.title: Add CyberPower PDUs
manual.description: Add one or more PDUs by IP address or hostname — use the add button to add a row for each. They share the port, SNMP version, and credentials you enter.

data_description.snmp_version: v1 is the simplest. Use v3 if you have configured a USM user.

credentials.title: SNMP credentials
credentials.description: Credentials applied to the {count} selected PDU(s). For SNMP v1/v2c the defaults (public / private) match a factory PDU; the write community is required to control outlets.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach any selected PDU over SNMP. Check the address, port, and credentials.
error.not_cyberpower: That device responded to SNMP but is not a CyberPower PDU.
error.cannot_identify: The PDU did not report a serial number or MAC address, so it cannot be identified reliably.
error.no_devices_selected: Select at least one PDU, or go back to enter an IP manually.
error.no_hosts: Add at least one IP address or hostname.
error.invalid_subnet: That doesn't look like a valid subnet, range, or IP address.
error.subnet_too_large: That range is too large to scan. Use a /22 or smaller (up to 1024 addresses).
error.no_devices_found: No CyberPower PDUs responded in that subnet. Check the range and read community, or add PDUs by IP.
